subject: ACME private offer: SKU split, passback and reseller margin plan
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Dana Li <dana.li@resellco.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging question for private offer + reseller margin

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're finalizing the internal request for a private offer across GCP and Azure and have two quick asks before procurement signs off:

1) Can you confirm whether SKU-level pricing is supported for a single private offer that spans both GCP and Azure, or do we need separate POs per cloud?
2) Our reseller (ResellCo) needs clarity on the passback flow — they asked what percentage of list price they should expect to retain (they prefer a simple %-of-list approach). Can you share typical passback bands you operate with for midsize ISV deals (commonly accepted by marketplaces)?

I'm attaching our proposed commit schedule. If helpful, want to run a short call today to align.

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Director, Cloud Procurement
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme_commit_schedule.xlsx
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question for private offer + reseller margin

Sam — appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front:

- You can have one private offer per cloud. For a combined customer ask (GCP + Azure) we normally create two private offers (one per cloud) and align list/discounting so economics are consistent across both. That makes marketplace billing and commitment tracking cleaner.
- For reseller passback we typically operate in tiers: 5–10% on list for self-serve SaaS packages, 10–18% for committed-enterprise motions with moderate MRR, and 18–25% for high-touch channel motions with co-sell. That said, marketplaces sometimes require pass-through calculations depending on SKU mapping.

I'll loop in Lauren and Marcus to confirm operational constraints and whether we can provide a single view for Acme in our pricing sheet.

Next steps: if you can confirm whether Acme prefers one consolidated billing view or two distinct POs per cloud, we'll draft the offer scaffolding and provide a sample passback waterfall.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question for private offer + reseller margin

Sam — quick operational notes from the marketplace side:

- GCP and Azure mandates: both clouds want a private offer per marketplace (so two offers). We can produce an internal consolidated view (one commercial workbook) that maps both offers to a single Redwood deal id for Acme. That keeps finance happy while satisfying marketplace technical constraints.
- SKU-level mapping: important for passback. If you want a flat %-of-list passback to ResellCo, we need to ensure the SKUs that are eligible for passback are mapped consistently across both clouds. We'll flag any platform-only SKUs (carrier/support) that should be excluded.
- Typical passback we see accepted in deals like this: 10% on base compute/serving SKUs for committed tiers, 15% on addon/support/implementation package SKUs, with an overall blended passback target of ~12–13% depending on the commit profile.

Attached: sku_mapping.csv (working). Can you confirm which SKUs Acme considers eligible for reseller commission?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sku_mapping.csv
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question for private offer + reseller margin

Adding ops granularity and a quick checklist. We need the following from Acme to finalize the two private offers and the reseller passback flow:

- Final commit quantities by month (we can accept ranges but need a floor for commit pricing)
- Which SKUs should be flagged as commission-eligible (yes/no per SKU)
- Confirmation of reseller legal name and tax profile (for marketplace disbursement)
- Whether Acme wants list-price anchoring on a single SKU for discount waterfalls or per-cloud list anchoring

Operational constraints: if Acme requests blended billing (one invoice), that will require a custom reconciliation work and an ops fee — estimate $2,500 one-time to cover mapping and reconciliation in our billing system. If they accept separate invoices per cloud, no fee.

I'm attaching our Redwood PO template to speed procurement (redwood_po_template.pdf). If the customer is ready, Ben — can you confirm the commitment table and we will stage the two private offers?

Marcus Lin
Director, Cloud Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_po_template.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, Dana Li <dana.li@resellco.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question for private offer + reseller margin

Sam — thanks, all. Quick summary and next steps so procurement has a clear checklist:

1) We'll provision two private offers (one for GCP marketplace, one for Azure marketplace) and publish a consolidated commercial workbook that maps both offers to ACME-PO-2025-07. No functional differences in discounting; the offers will be aligned.
2) Proposed passback: suggest we start with a blended 12% passback to ResellCo for commission-eligible SKUs (detailed in attached sku_mapping.csv). Dana — please confirm ResellCo legal/tax info and whether 12% aligns with your comp model.
3) If Acme wants single-invoice consolidated billing, there's a $2,500 one-time ops fee. Otherwise separate invoices per cloud (default) at no fee.
4) Next materials: I'll upload the signed PO to DocuSign and share the link. Expect a follow-up with the two marketplace private-offer IDs and passback waterfall by Monday.

Sam — can you confirm (a) preferred billing (single vs separate), (b) acceptance of the 12% blended passback, and (c) confirm the commit floor in the attached schedule? If you approve, we'll send the DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_commit_schedule.xlsx
